title: The Prince and the Pauper
subtitle: 考点：故事概要 / exchange / by accident
passage: The Prince and the Pauper is a famous story by Mark Twain. It is about two boys in England who look exactly alike. One is Edward, the prince. The other is Tom, a poor boy who lives in a small street.

One day, the two boys meet by accident. Edward is interested in Tom's life, and Tom is curious about the palace. They decide to exchange clothes. Soon the prince is in the street in old clothes, and nobody believes that he is a prince. Tom is in the palace, but he does not know the rules.

Each boy learns a lot. Edward finds out how hard life is for poor people. Tom learns that being rich does not always make people happy. In the end, they go back to their own lives. The story shows that people can look alike but have very different lives.
vocab: pauper 穷人 · alike 相像的 · exchange 交换 · by accident 偶然 · palace 宫殿 · rich 富有的 · rule 规则
